detail.q: What is the capital of Japan?
detail.a: The capital of Japan is Tokyo. It is the nation's largest city and a major global hub for finance and culture.

detail.q: Who wrote Hamlet?
detail.a: William Shakespeare wrote Hamlet. He is widely considered the greatest playwright in English history. The play explores themes of revenge, madness, and mortality.

detail.q: What is the chemical symbol for gold?
detail.a: The chemical symbol for gold is Au. It comes from the Latin word for gold, which means "shining." Gold is a precious metal with atomic number 79.

detail.q: Which planet is the largest in our solar system?
detail.a: Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system. It is massive enough to hold all the other planets inside it. Its size makes it the most prominent feature in the night sky.

detail.q: What does CPU stand for?
detail.a: CPU stands for Central Processing Unit. It is the brain of your computer that handles all the calculations and instructions. Without it, your machine would just be a slow, empty shell.

detail.q: How many days are in a leap year?
detail.a: A leap year has 366 days. The extra day is added to February to keep our calendar in sync with the Earth's orbit around the sun.

detail.q: At what Celsius temperature does water boil at sea level?
detail.a: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level. This is the standard temperature where liquid water turns to steam under normal atmospheric pressure.

detail.q: What is the powerhouse of the cell?
detail.a: The powerhouse of the cell is the mitochondria. It generates most of the cell's supply of adenosine triphosphate (ATP), used as a source of chemical energy. Without it, cells would struggle to perform essential functions.

detail.q: Differentiate between accuracy and error in AI.
detail.a: Accuracy measures how often an AI gets the right answer, while error is the opposite: the count of wrong predictions. High accuracy means low error, but they are just two sides of the same coin. Think of accuracy as a score and error as the mistakes subtracted from that total.

detail.q: What is the better metric if you had to choose one, accuracy or F1?
detail.a: F1 is usually better because it balances precision and recall, whereas accuracy can be misleading on imbalanced datasets. If your data has many negative examples, accuracy might be high even if your model fails to catch important positives. F1 ensures you aren't ignoring the minority class that matters most.

detail.q: Explain what a neural network is, simply.
detail.a: A neural network is a computer system inspired by the human brain. It uses many connected units to learn patterns from data. Think of it as a digital brain that gets smarter the more it practices.

detail.q: I am tired but I have to finish my homework. Any advice?
detail.a: Take a quick sip of water and stretch your arms. Set a timer for twenty minutes and focus only on that one task. If you get stuck, write down the problem and come back to it later.

detail.q: Give me a one line summary of how photosynthesis works.
detail.a: Photosynthesis is how plants use sunlight to turn carbon dioxide and water into sugar and oxygen.

detail.q: Should I learn Python or C first? Pick one.
detail.a: Start with Python because its simple syntax lets you focus on logic rather than syntax. C is powerful but requires mastering memory management before you can build anything useful. Python gets you coding quickly, which is the best way to learn.

detail.q: What can you do?
detail.a: I can answer questions, do simple math with a calculator, and help you find information. I cannot browse the live web or control your computer directly. What would you like to do?
